summary: The implementation appears to be largely complete, covering authentication with Internet Identity, doubt posting with photo attachments, answer functionality with file and video attachments, rating system, points tracking, and leaderboard. However, several important requirements are missing or only partially implemented, particularly around REQ-2 (doubt title), REQ-4 (one-rating-per-user enforcement), and REQ-8 (generated images). Some hallucinated features were also identified.

missing_requirements.requirement: Junior users can create a new doubt post with a title and description
missing_requirements.reason: The DoubtForm.tsx component and backend Doubt type only include 'description' field. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires both title and description, but title is missing entirely from the implementation.

missing_requirements.requirement: A user can only rate an answer once
missing_requirements.reason: The RatingInput.tsx component uses local state (hasRated) to prevent duplicate ratings, but this is client-side only and does not persist across sessions or enforce the constraint at the backend level. There is no backend validation or storage to prevent a user from rating the same answer multiple times.

missing_requirements.requirement: Bonus points are awarded for highly rated answers (e.g., 4+ stars)
missing_requirements.reason: The backend main.mo file includes basic point tracking and awarding points when an answer is rated, but there is no evidence of special bonus point logic for highly rated answers (4+ stars). The rateAnswer function only appears to award standard points, not conditional bonuses based on rating value.

missing_requirements.requirement: Generated images are stored in frontend/public/assets/generated
missing_requirements.reason: The diff does not show any generated images being added to frontend/public/assets/generated. Components reference image paths (e.g., '/assets/generated/trophy-icon.dim_128x128.png', '/assets/generated/notes-icon.dim_64x64.png', '/assets/generated/video-icon.dim_64x64.png'), but the actual image files are not present in the added files list.

hallucinated_features.description: Dark mode theme support with extensive dark: variants throughout the UI
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest specifies a warm, friendly color palette with clear typography but does not request dark mode functionality. The implementation includes comprehensive dark mode styling across all components (e.g., 'dark:from-gray-900', 'dark:text-gray-100'), which was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Upload progress indicators with Progress component
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not mention upload progress tracking or progress bars. The implementation includes progress indicators for file uploads in DoubtForm and AnswerForm, which is a feature beyond the specified requirements.

hallucinated_features.description: Relative timestamp formatting (e.g., 'Just now', '5m ago', '3h ago')
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest specifies that doubts should show timestamp, but does not request relative time formatting. DoubtCard.tsx implements a sophisticated formatTimestamp function that converts timestamps to relative time strings, which was not explicitly requested.
